name: example-client-plugin
description: A MindRoom client plugin for the tests: renders messages that carry com.example.greeting, adds two side panels, one whose rows, menu and dialog are the app's own and which shows a greeting's text as the app renders an agent's reply, and one that draws its own frame and says the app's theme kind and screen size and previews a PDF, a room header action, three slash commands and two room menu entries, one of them critical, shows a banner under the room header, whose words its build module writes in and which names the thread the room shows, and covers the conversation.
